separator.$description: Purely presentational — no interactive states, unlike every other component built so far (buttons, fields, pagination all react to hover/focus/press; a divider never does). Horizontal and vertical orientation, per how Radix/shadcn/MUI/Mantine all model this component (researched, not guessed). One thickness only (1px, a literal in the generated CSS, not a token) — no design system scales hairline width the way it scales spacing or typography, checked across the same references.

color.$description: border.default's own $description already says '...card edges, dividers, input borders at rest' — written in the very first semantic-color session, before this component existed.

label.$description: The horizontal-with-label variant (a line, the label, a line — e.g. an 'OR' divider between a form and a social-login row). Vertical dividers don't get a label variant — rare/awkward in every reference checked, always just a plain line filling the available height.
